coverage.forests: Every noncoarsened context keeps every nondominant spherical partition and every allowed defect profile. Coarse branches record their complete uniform aggregate rows or local component-cap exit, never silently omit a context.

coverage.non_energy_exits: Only explicit local component/entire-forest contradictions; no final dimension-exclusion theorem is a row.
coverage.ranks: Every actual rank18..29 independently; no rank deletion or face inheritance.
